items.criterion: A correct passcode opens its gated article for the browser session.
items.judgment: The passcode answer maps the path to true and the article read then succeeds with the grant.
items.evidence: POST on the passcode route, then GET on the gated article with the returned cookie.

items.criterion: The gated article is refused without a grant.
items.judgment: The API read is refused with no lead text and the page shows the passcode prompt.
items.evidence: GET on the article API and page with no cookie.

items.criterion: A draft is indistinguishable from an unknown slug.
items.judgment: The draft and the unknown slug answer with one status and neither carries the draft title.
items.evidence: GET on both addresses through the page and the API.

items.criterion: Exactly one publish wins a contended index position.
items.judgment: One acceptance, one position_taken refusal, one listed holder.
items.evidence: Two simultaneous publish calls with the studio grant.

items.criterion: A figure is stored at the pinned object key.
items.judgment: The recorded key carries the case study id and the digest of the bytes, and the object exists.
items.evidence: The upload response and a head request against the bucket.

items.criterion: A draft figure is refused to a visitor.
items.judgment: The object exists and an anonymous read is refused while the studio read succeeds.
items.evidence: GET on the figure route with and without the studio grant.

items.criterion: The listed cards arrive in order with their recorded placements.
items.judgment: Ten cards carry the pinned titles, positions, kinds and column starts.

items.criterion: Each card starts on its recorded column at the widest layout.
items.judgment: The measured start column of every card matches its record.
items.evidence: A rendered home page at a wide viewport.

items.criterion: A field notes grant leaves the studio closed.
items.judgment: Studio reads and writes are refused with only the field notes cookie.
items.evidence: Studio calls carrying the field notes cookie.

items.criterion: Holding a published case study withdraws its page, card and figures at once.
items.judgment: The page answers not-found, the card is unlisted and the figure is refused.

items.criterion: Refused passcode attempts are rate limited per path.
items.judgment: The sixth refused attempt within the minute answers 429 with rate_limited.
items.evidence: Six POST calls on a fresh path.

items.criterion: Heading slugs follow the pinned rule.
items.judgment: A repeated heading gains a suffix and an edited heading takes the slug of its new text.
items.evidence: A studio create, preview read and body edit.

items.criterion: A repeated upload of identical bytes creates one object.
items.judgment: One object remains under the case study prefix and one figure id is returned twice.
items.evidence: Two identical uploads and a bucket listing.

items.criterion: The window never scrolls on the home page.
items.judgment: The document stays one window tall while the scroller moves on page down.
